name: Gardwen
description: Feral-raised elf druid and lone survivor of a Dragon Knight raid; a rank-1 divine caster of nature and pure-water magic who walks with a befriended she-wolf, searching for her long-lost brother.
narrative:
A feral-raised elf druid and the sole survivor of a Dragon Knight raid that killed her family roughly ten years ago. Gardwen channels the magic of nature and pure water and travels with a befriended she-wolf, Ruhi. She is searching for her brother, taken during the raid as a child -- now, unknown to her, the possessed warrior serving Baron Hanzo di Teufel. Dark hair, blue eyes; soft-spoken but fierce in defense of kin and the wild. She journeys with the old warrior-protector Magda (an emissary of the death goddess Hel) toward Zorastor, following the Dragon Knights.

**The old ways gave her more than healing.** The grove that remade itself around eight murdered
people did not teach her herbs alone. She carries the **woodland set** of the binding school --
Spirit Sight, Speak with the Bound, **Unseat**, Sanctuary -- learned in a place thick with people
who died badly, where such things are not theory.

There is no attack spell in it and there never was. **Unseat is a burial rite:** you put your hands
on somebody who is carrying a passenger and you refuse to let go until it can leave. It cannot be
forced on a spirit that is holding on -- and a spirit held by torment counts as holding on until
somebody addresses the torment, which is what Speak with the Bound is for.

She has never used any of it on a person. She has used it twice on animals and once on a place.

abilities: The Wild Line, Woodwise -- see powers
extras.source: Roll20 Classic Fantasy character sheet (And then the Dragons Came campaign)
extras.player_notes: Dark hair, blue eyes. Female wolf named Ruhi. Older woman/protector - Magda - emissary of goddess of death. Following Dragonshits to Zorastor. Lord Santo was attacker of elven woman Emmerelda. Hanzo (dad). Baron Hesper - mage/sorcerer - 'power behind the throne'. Constantine (Sylph's Embrace) and Marisette (Aphrodisias) - madames. Randall, Conall and Santo are all identical -- Hanzo is the father of all three. Brother taken by dragons as a child - dead or alive? Hanzo leads the Dragonshits. Brother's name? Gabriel. Conall: the warrior lady (Tamarack?) here to stop Hanzo. Santo is a fire-wielding magician, equal power to Conall. Soul blade -- used to bind a spirit in a body (possession), crafted by a necromancer. Girl who hugged me - Ila, 13.
extras.source_class: Druid (Classic Fantasy class; mapped to Cleric in CFI's four core classes -- divine caster)
extras.spell_access: CFI cleric, Rank 2: access to every cleric spell of that Rank or below. "memorized" is what is currently prayed for, not what she can have.

actor_notes:
Gardwen -- PLAYER CHARACTER. Do not write a card for her and do not play her.
Who she is, what she wants, what she is protecting and what she becomes under
pressure all belong to the player. The GM describes the world she is standing in
and never her thoughts, her feelings, her conclusions or her decisions
(TABLE.md section 5). If you find yourself wanting notes here, what you actually
want is to stop narrating her.
